en: How we yearn and hope for the love He has for us How we yearn and hope for the peace from His love

ko: 너의 모든 것 창조하신 우리 주님이
en: How we yearn to learn the depth of His love The love of our creator
How we seek to worship and praise our Lord How we seek to be good like you, O Lord

ko: 너의 모든 것 창조하신 우리 주님이
en: You have cleansed us, saved us, and said to each of us You are my treasured child
Oh Lord, we know You’re watching us With Your eyes of everlasting love
O Lord, we know You hear our prayers With Your ears of unfailing love
You shed a light to the darkest path And You answer every prayer, big or small

ko: 너는 어느 곳에 있든지 주를 향하고
en: No matter when it is or where we stand We will set our eyes on You
